applicabilityBasis.summary: crvUSD is a transferable dollar-targeted stablecoin distributed through crypto-collateralized borrowing markets and LLAMMA liquidations. Curve DAO retains Factory and debt-ceiling controls, but the reviewed disclosures do not identify a legal issuer obligated to redeem holders for a fixed amount of currency or bank-deposit monetary value. Its general dollar-stablecoin use and unresolved issuer obligation make GENIUS applicability unclear.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. Official materials identify Curve DAO governance of minting infrastructure, markets and debt ceilings; no named legal payment-stablecoin issuer or legal currency-redemption obligor was established. Do not equate DAO control with Liquity-style immutability or automatically infer full decentralization. No GENIUS approval, state-qualified status, official application or registered foreign exception was found in the checked sources. No issuerEntity is supplied because Curve DAO branding is not an evidenced exact legal entity. Prudential implementation remains proposed; the September 30 SCRC rule is procedural. This finding does not assert GENIUS non-compliance or prohibit DASP offers before the applicable statutory timelines.

sourcesChecked: GENIUS Act Public Law 119-27, sections 2, 3 and 20

Independent official-domain searches on 2026-10-07 for Liquity, BOLD, LUSD, crvUSD and Curve DAO with GENIUS, stablecoin approval, application, enforcement and sanctions across OCC, FDIC, NCUA, Federal Reserve, NYDFS, Federal Register, SEC, CFTC and Treasury domains; no qualifying named public approval/application, registration or token-specific action found.
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the opened regulator materials, directories, protocol disclosures and token/name-specific official-domain searches did not identify a public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application or registered foreign-issuer exception for crvUSD. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located in the searched domains. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no unpublished application exists; generic bank-charter or virtual-currency licensing would not establish these statuses.
